name: the chase clock
note: A chain stops as a GAP after four moves of ours with no irreversible event that is not bad for us (an echo of the fifty-move rule: the events are the kernel's, Game.clock_events -- a capture, a pawn move -- of which the clock counts ours and their captures; four is a hyperparameter: the module's CHASE_CLOCK starts from moves, a harness may set it; from_tier on it is at most at_most).
